# ibee_block_storage_plans (Data Source)

The block storage plans the API lists (GET /block-storage/plans), as the portal's Create Volume page shows them. Use a plan's sku_code for ibee_block_volume; the API decides which SKU and size a create accepts.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ibee_block_storage_plans" "all" {
  site_id = "SITE_ID"
}

output "block_storage_sku_codes" {
  value = data.ibee_block_storage_plans.all.plans[*].sku_code
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billing_interval` | `string` | Optional | HOURLY or MONTHLY: the interval the listed prices are quoted for. Omit to use the API's default (MONTHLY). |
| `currency` | `string` | Optional | Price currency, such as INR. Omit to use the API's default (INR). |
| `plans` | `list(object)` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.allowed_sizes_gb` | `list(number)` | Read-only | From included_usage, when the API reports it. |
| `plans.billing_catalog` | `string` | Read-only | The plan's billing_catalog as a JSON object, when the API returns one. |
| `plans.description` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.included_usage` | `string` | Read-only | The plan's included_usage object (sizes, performance, prices) as JSON, as the API returns it. Use jsondecode to read other fields. |
| `plans.iops` | `string` | Read-only | From included_usage: display text, for example Up to 10K. |
| `plans.max_size_gb` | `number` | Read-only | From included_usage, when the API reports it as a number. |
| `plans.min_size_gb` | `number` | Read-only | From included_usage, when the API reports it as a number. |
| `plans.name` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.plan_code` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.price_per_gb_month_minor` | `number` | Read-only | From included_usage, in the currency's minor unit. |
| `plans.selectable` | `bool` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.sku_code` | `string` | Read-only | Send as sku_code of ibee_block_volume. |
| `plans.status` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.storage_type` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `plans.throughput` | `string` | Read-only | From included_usage: display text, for example Up to 400 MiB/s. |
| `site_id` | `string` | Optional | Return only plans offered at this site. |
